title: Oopa Artifacts
subtitle: Test your grasp of Oopa Artifacts — Out Of Place Artefacts, Energy Weapons, giants, Tuning Forks, Atmospheric Condensers, and the suppression of pre-reset proof.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Oopas are not curios. They are the bones of a free-energy world murdered by Resets — fossilised hats and books from frequency weapons, giant femurs vaulted by the Smithsonian, Tuning Forks that turned stone to putty, copper condensers melted so coal could rule. Titanic took crystal and forks. WW1 took the living memory of ages 15 to 55. Orphan Trains seeded amnesia into half-buried cities. Lunatic Asylums farmed Loosh from the shell-shocked. Evolution was the Freemason cover story for a downgrade from levitation to the stone wheel. Sit with what was stolen. When the frequency overlays peel, those who know Oopa legacy will recognize the original plain — not collapse with the false timeline.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Oopa (Out Of Place Artefacts)” refers to blatant physical evidence and items left behind from high technological civilizations that existed before the current reset, completely contradicting the accepted historical narrative.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Oopa (Out Of Place Artefacts)” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Oopa (Out Of Place Artefacts)” as: Blatant physical evidence and items left behind from high technological civilizations that existed before the current reset, completely contradicting the accepted historical narrative.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Oopa (Out Of Place Artefacts)”.

questions.question: What are Resets in relation to Tartaria and the population?

options.rationale: Not what the report says. Resets are orchestrated wipe-and-harvest events that erase free-energy civilizations such as Tartaria and reseed controllable primitivism.

options.label: B
options.text: Pre-planned planetary events executed by parasitic forces to wipe out advanced civilizations, harvest populations for energy, and reset knowledge to a primitive, controllable state.
options.rationale: Resets are orchestrated wipe-and-harvest events that erase free-energy civilizations such as Tartaria and reseed controllable primitivism.

options.label: C
options.text: Periods of war between the parasitic factions, in which civilizations are damaged in the fighting and the survivors are left to rebuild without outside help.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Resets are orchestrated wipe-and-harvest events that erase free-energy civilizations such as Tartaria and reseed controllable primitivism.

options.label: D
options.text: Changes of rulers in which the old elite is replaced by a new bloodline, with the population and its knowledge left in place but its history rewritten.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Resets are orchestrated wipe-and-harvest events that erase free-energy civilizations such as Tartaria and reseed controllable primitivism.

questions.hint: Planned wipe, harvest, and knowledge reset — Tartaria destroyed.

questions.question: What characterized Tartaria before its eradication?

options.rationale: Not what the report says. Tartaria was world-scale free-energy excellence with crystalline temples, erased to lock in scarcity.

options.label: B
options.text: A network of independent city-states that shared a style of domed architecture, but had no free energy and fell apart through wars between its members.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Tartaria was world-scale free-energy excellence with crystalline temples, erased to lock in scarcity.

options.label: C
options.text: A globally advanced pre-reset civilization of resplendent architecture, crystalline healing temples, and free electromagnetic energy, eradicated to enforce scarcity.
options.rationale: Tartaria was world-scale free-energy excellence with crystalline temples, erased to lock in scarcity.

options.label: D
options.text: A civilization that left the realm voluntarily through the Ice Wall portals, abandoning its cities to the people who arrived after the reset had passed.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Tartaria was world-scale free-energy excellence with crystalline temples, erased to lock in scarcity.

questions.hint: Global free-energy civilization — temples, architecture, then eradicated.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

The report defines “Oopa (Out Of Place Artefacts)” as: Blatant physical evidence and items left behind from high technological civilizations that existed before the current reset, completely contradicting the accepted historical narrative.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

options.rationale: The real arc is downgrade from 9th-density perfection into 3rd-density control, not ape-to-modern ascent.

options.label: C
options.text: Density never changed; only clothing styles evolved while electromagnetic architecture stayed identical across every epoch.
options.rationale: Density was forced down from 9th to 3rd; free-energy architecture was stripped after resets.

options.label: D
options.text: Modern society already restored full 9th-density crystalline operation through coal plants and central banks alone.
options.rationale: Coal and finance lock scarcity; 9th-density crystalline reality remains suppressed under overlays.

questions.hint: Downgrade from 9th-density perfection to 3rd-density control.
